facts.text: Hotel Neri is in the heart of the Gothic Quarter, surrounded by the old Jewish quarter.
facts.excerpt: Situado en el corazón del Barrio Gótico y rodeado del antiguo barrio judío

facts.text: Hotel Neri occupies two historic buildings, one of them a 12th-century medieval palace.
facts.excerpt: siendo uno de ellos un magnífico palacio medieval del siglo XII

facts.text: The palace's old courtyard was recovered and its sgraffito decoration restored.
facts.excerpt: del que se recuperó el antiguo patio y se restauraron

facts.text: The hotel's interior design is by Virginia Figueras and Franco Corada.
facts.excerpt: El diseño interior integral del hotel, proyectado por Virginia Figueras y Franco Corada

facts.text: Rooms are decorated with photographs from the La Mirada Transeunte collection.
facts.excerpt: decoradas con fotografías de la colección La Mirada Transeúnte

facts.text: Classic rooms have views of the Gothic Quarter.
facts.excerpt: las habitaciones Classic tienen vistas al Barrio Gótico

facts.text: The Deluxe Balcony room is the only one with a balcony looking onto Plaza Sant Felip Neri.
facts.excerpt: la habitación Deluxe Balcony es la única que permite asomarse a su balcón

facts.text: Deluxe Terrace rooms have a terrace with a relaxation area and an outdoor bathtub.
facts.excerpt: cuentan con una terraza que incluye zona de relax y bañera exterior

facts.text: The Suite has a separate sitting area and keeps its original restored ceilings.
facts.excerpt: Con una zona de estar separada, la espaciosa habitación Suite mantiene los techos originales restaurados

facts.text: a Restaurant is the only restaurant located on Plaza Sant Felip Neri.
facts.excerpt: a Restaurant es el único restaurante ubicado en la Plaza

facts.text: Roba Estesa is a rooftop terrace surrounded by greenery on the hotel's top floor.
facts.excerpt: En la última planta del hotel te espera Roba Estesa, un auténtico oasis urbano. Una discreta terraza rodeada de verde

facts.text: Hotel Neri describes itself as the only Relais & Chateaux hotel in the city.
The hotel's spaces can be fully privatised for events on request, subject to availability.
Conde Nast Traveler describes the hotel as hidden down a tiny, quiet alleyway off one of the prettiest squares in the Gothic Quarter.
facts.excerpt: hidden down a tiny, quiet alleyway off one of the prettiest squares in

facts.text: A sleep preferences menu lets guests choose cotton, satin or linen sheets and down or hypoallergenic pillows.
facts.excerpt: The sleep preferences menu allows guests to choose from sheets made of cotton, satin, or linen as well as down or hypoallergnic pillows.

facts.text: Many of the natural stone bathrooms have both a bathtub and a rain shower.
facts.excerpt: Many of the peaceful, natural stone bathrooms have both a bathtub and rain shower.

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler says the Roba Estesa rooftop is reserved for guests and private events.
facts.excerpt: it’s reserved just for guests and private events

facts.text: Conde Nast Traveler calls the Junior Suite the best room, with views of Sant Felip Neri square.
facts.excerpt: The best room in the house is definitely the Junior Suite, with its views of the charming Sant Felipe Neri Square below.
